concerns.text: The power analysis uses `statsmodels.stats.power.TTestIndPower`, which assumes a two‑sample t‑test on means. The primary inferential tests in the plan are a Kolmogorov–Smirnov test and a permutation test on distributional differences, not a t‑test. Consequently the reported power (≈0.68) and detectable effect size (≈0.45) are not valid for the chosen non‑parametric tests, making the power calculation mismatched to the methodology.
